events.title: EPR Properties Expands Experiential Portfolio With Six Flags Deal And Valuation Gap
events.body: EPR Properties (NYSE:EPR) completed a $315 million acquisition of a Six Flags regional park portfolio, its largest post-COVID investment. The deal adds multiple regional theme park assets to EPR's experiential-focused real estate portfolio.
